title: Naani
desc: Soon after moving into their new palatial house, a couple begins experiencing paranormal phenomena. An investigation leads them to the chilling story of the house's previous inhabitants.

title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Hejjaru
desc: A man haunted by a thirty-year-old cold case discovers a young stranger suffering the exact same tragedy, leading him to follow the youth into a rabbit hole.

title: Vedha
desc: A father and daughter embark on a killing spree in a bid to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. However, a police officer seeks to put an end to their murders.
